Returns coverage per residue

Source: R/inside_functions_plot.R
coverage_residue.Rd

returns vector with coverage information

Usage

coverage_residue(df1, start_col, end_col)

Arguments

df1

output from functions output_tp or output_tp_proc.

start_col

number of "Start" column in data.frame

end_col

number of "Start" column in data.frame

Value

vector with coverage per residue

Examples

file_nm<-system.file("extdata", "All_results_table.csv", package = "HDXBoxeR")
a<- output_tp(file_nm)
#> Protein.States used: Unbound bound
#> Deut.times used: 3.00s 60.00s 1800.00s 72000.00s
#> 29 peptide row(s) dropped: 29 not measured in every state, 0 with fewer than 2 replicate value(s)
#> Number of replicates used: Unbound=3 bound=3
#> no csv file written
coverage_residue(df1=a,start_col=2, end_col=3 )
